args.body: Take COMMISSIONED-TECHNICAL-ARTICLE-FIT. The WTD result rejected access to employment listings, not all paid technical writing. Test a defined commissioned deliverable instead, with publisher AI policy and submission/payment prerequisites checked before any article production. Maximum three named publishers; reuse executed evidence and stop on a bounded rejection. No outgoing contact is authorized. Four unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand; advertised compensation is neither funding nor revenue. Preserve all existing deadlines.

description: The documentation job-board test found no inspectable paid tasks; this rejects that channel, not documentation demand.
